input: Deterministic synthetic 1920x1080 RGBA images, seed 42. No user screen, OCR, subscription inference or network requests.

fixtures.document: Flat light background and repeated dark text-like strokes
fixtures.mixed: Document with random RGB pixels at x>1000 and y>400
fixtures.noise: Random RGB pixels across the entire opaque image

webview.method: Independent hidden production Wails v2 app, memory asset handler, Cache-Control no-store, new Image().decode(), unique query per pass, same 1920x1080 pixels; each image encoded once before startup.
webview.limitations: Sequential fixed order, three passes, background compilation/test load. encode_once_ms are uncontrolled preparation samples, not evidence for encoding speed. Decode includes asset transfer and decoding. These are synthetic fixtures, not a replay of the user's capture.

go_encoding.method: Each ns/op includes selection when adaptive, then PNG encoding, without base64 or WebView. Two samples of three iterations per case. No concurrent heavy commands intentionally launched during this run; other system load uncontrolled.
go_encoding.interpretation: Adaptive selects best-speed for the document, no-compression for mixed/noise. Encoding the document costs more CPU but transfers far fewer bytes. Timing variation does not establish encoding gains for mixed/noise. Do not sum timings from separate benchmark runs as an end-to-end result.

production_policy: Keep images below one million pixels uncompressed. For larger frames, compress a 16x16 distributed RGBA sample with flate.BestSpeed; choose PNG BestSpeed only when that sample compresses to <=20%, otherwise NoCompression. Never encode the whole frame twice. OCR EncodePNGBytes retains NoCompression. Resolution and pixels are preserved.

other_findings.reply_setup: Latest user log: a reply discarded an unused translation thread (unsubscribe32ms + config125ms + thread/start787ms). Prepare the known reply scene/input prompt during selection, retaining the configured reply effort. This does not establish a reduction in the separate ~9.9s model first-output wait.
other_findings.rejected_experiment: HTTP gzip around an uncompressed PNG failed Image.decode in the tested Wails host; not applied to production.
